name: TIC 55480032
description: A red giant observed by TESS, 10.7 solar radii and 1.34 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,016 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.34 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,841 K at its surface.
